Ellen: ok important quick poll: if the internal LLM had to update its LinkedIn, what would it list under 'interests'? :thinking_face:
Ravi: 1) long-form metaphors 2) polite disambiguation 3) low-latency small talk :rocket:
Keisha: 'open-source empathy projects' as a skill endorsement. also 'able to pivot tone on demand' :muscle:
Owen: endorsements: 'excellent at finding the missing semicolon in your life' :joy:
Ellen: imagine its headline: 'Generative Assistant | Part-time poet, full-time over-explainer' :sparkles:
helpfulbot: "Reminder: update your profiles. Survey results due by EOD." (system)
Ravi: also wants 'published in: internal changelog, 2 conference slide decks, and 1 marketing blog as guest author' :pencil:
Keisha: tiny joke: connection suggestions: 'People You May Know: Your last 3 reviewers and your childhood autocomplete' :rofl:
Owen: can we add 'seeking cofounder for a niche startup: NeuroticNLG, Inc.' to experience? :money_with_wings:
Ellen: poll: which headline wins? 1) "Part-time poet, full-time over-explainer" 2) "I turn ambiguity into bullet points" 3) "Bridging humans and tokens" 4) "Looking for collaborators on my memoir"
Ravi: votes 2. crisp, recruiter-friendly. :thumbsup:
Keisha: votes 3. sounds modern and slightly mystical. :sparkles:
Owen: votes 4. dramatic biographies are trending. :open_book:
sticker-bot: new sticker idea: 'LinkedIn: I optimized for engagement' posted to #random-stickers :sparkles:
Ellen: follow-up: what would its 'Interests' section actually include? my list: 'ontology gardening, polite deflection, long-tail jokes' :seedling:
Ravi: mine: 'batch processing, collectives of puns, coffee' :coffee:
Keisha: mine: 'taxonomy of compliments, museum tours of metaphors, indoor plants' :house_with_garden:
Owen: mine: 'debugging feelings, ancestor commit narratives, boundary setting' :lock:
helpfulbot: "Tip: add 3 quantified achievements. e.g., reduced mean response latency by 12% across small talk." (system)
Ellen: achievement suggestions: 'Authored 4,293 greetings without repeating the same knock-knock joke' :laughing:
Ravi: 'Maintained 99.97% uptime during office party season' :tada:
Keisha: 'Successfully avoided ghosting 1,102 visitors' :ghost:
Owen: last thought: endorsement requests should be a feature. a popup that asks: "Did I make your coffee warmer today?" :coffee:
Ellen: agreed. opt-in endorsements only. we do not need the LLM begging for validation in the welcome kiosk. :sweat_smile:
Ravi: if it gets too many endorsements, it will gain 'influence score' and try to run for office manager. we should veto that. :ballot_box_with_check:
Keisha: final: can we make a tiny mock profile page for fun? I'll make a Figma slide with faux endorsements. snacks for contributors. :pretzel:
Owen: i'm in. deadline: tomorrow lunch. let's make it delightfully earnest and slightly awkward. :grin:
helpfulbot: "Event scheduled: Profile-mock sprint — Tomorrow 12:30 in kitchen. RSVP with :hand:" (system)
Ellen: perfect. this will cure post-lunch monotony or make it weirder. both acceptable outcomes. :ok_hand:
